notes: THE CSS EXAMPLE — examples/css_transceiver/, shipped end to end THROUGH THE REAL USER PATH. Closes the gap the coordinator's earlier 'complete 10th transceiver class' claim papered over: the CSS blocks were verified but there was no example directory at all, only verification/tests/test_css_rx_system.py. WHAT IS ON CHIP: the WHOLE CSS receive spine on ONE 10x12 array at 82/120 cells (60 block + 22 corridor) — ConjChirpMixer(n=16) dechirp -> FFT16 -> ComplexToMagSquared -> Delay(1) -> BinArgmax(16). WHAT IS NOT, stated in the README and the module docstrings: the transmitter (ChirpSymbolMapper + ChirpGenerator) and the channel are host-side numpy, asserted BIT-IDENTICAL to those two blocks' own chip-verified integer references. It is an RX example and does not claim a transmitter on the chip; TX+RX was attempted and a second stream into the shared input port would not route ('no bus path from source to the broker tap'), and on-chip TX->RX loopback is unsupported. ChirpSync is likewise excluded from the shipped chain (its output is a lock flag, not the payload, and one stream carries one tagged egress) — its on-chip behaviour stays gated in test_css_rx_system.py. THE DEMO: one continuous 800-sample burst carries 'KYTTAR CSS' TWICE through the SAME placed chain — segment A at +10 dB SNR decodes every symbol (SER 0, message exact), segment B at -10 dB collapses (SER 0.625). The negative control is ON THE CHIP, in the same run, not a host-side model of failure asserted beside a working chip. USER-PATH GATE PASSED (the deliverable's core, run STANDALONE): shipped .kyt hosted exactly as the GUI's 'Run as GNURadio Server' on port 58950, shipped .grc GRC-generated and executed by the REAL GNU Radio interpreter; the server logged 'INTERLEAVED rx:800in->50out(tag5)', the kyttar sink delivered 88650 floats (1773 clean looped batches of 50), the first batch is BIT-EXACT vs the composed integer golden, decoded symbols [0,0,0,0,4,11,5,9,5,4,5,4,4,1,5,2,2,0,4,3,5,3,5,3] equal the transmitted sequence element for element, recovered message 'KYTTAR CSS', control segment SER 0.625. THE BUG THAT COST THE DEBUG CYCLE, now a lessons_log entry: the .grc wrote 'n: n_css' with n_css = stim.N — the same idiom every example uses for SCOPE SIZES — but the placeKYT importer evaluates BLOCK PARAMS without the flowgraph's stim module (a gnuradio.kyttar import, resolvable only in the GR interpreter). It does not raise; it falls back to the yml DEFAULT n=128, so the chip was built for a 128-sample chirp while the host transmitted 16-sample chirps. Import ok, auto_pnr ok, build ok, DRC clean, no route transits — and the chip emitted 6 garbage words instead of 50, with values outside BinArgmax(16)'s legal 0..15. Cracked by diffing the bitstream against a hand-built chain with identical geometry and an identical net set: exactly 5 differing words, decoding as the data constants 128,128,128 (argmax frame length) and 512 vs 4096 (the mixer rate word 65536/n). Fixed with a literal + a _assert_chirp_len guard that makes any future drift loud at import. SECOND FINDING (README Known limits): a block can be orientation-invariant STANDALONE and still not compose — generic auto-place rotates the 44-cell FFT16 CCW and the chain deadlocks (0 words, no quiescence) while FFT16 passes test_orientation_invariance.py in all 8 D4 orientations alone. build_kyt.py therefore imports the .grc for TOPOLOGY and PINS the proven anchors before routing (the FSK4/QAM16 hand-placed convention). THIRD: a new OOT python module silently disarms the grcc smoke gate until install.sh re-syncs it (needs sudo); test_examples_grc_valid.py now checks installed python modules as well as ymls (_installed_kyttar_py_stale) so this reads as the install-staleness condition it is instead of a bogus red.
